title: zara malik - notes to self
content:
Daily scratchpad - 2026-03-04

Top priorities:
- [ ] Merge review for PR #567 (serving-runtime) - block from perf tests. Aim to finish review before EOD.
- [ ] Run quantization smoke tests on rtx-dedicated-2 (short sequence batch). Check memory regression.
- [ ] Confirm canary rollout schedule with SRE (Seema) - want canary at low traffic window 2-4am PDT on Friday.

Quick context / notes:
- PR #567 introduces adaptive batching knob. Ran unit tests locally (all green) but saw a 4% token latency bump in the automated perf job - need to dig into kernel selection heuristics.
- Quantization branch (zq/opt-quant) seems stable but KV cache invalidation test failing intermittently (likely race). Add more tracing around cache evict.

Follow-ups / owners:
- Seema: confirm rollback playbook for canary (asked in Slack @seema, waiting). If no reply by 3/6, escalate to on-call.
- Mateo: share latest throughput numbers for dedicated pool (needed for capacity calc).
- Priya: coordinate with QA for smoke tests on private deployment cluster.

Meeting notes (standup + infra sync):
- Standup: blocked on perf test flakiness, otherwise unblock for docs generation work.
- Infra sync: SRE proposed adding a fallback model variant policy by region - need product sign-off.

Personal TODOs (non-work):
- [ ] Dentist 10:30am Thu (confirm appointment - got reminder text)
- [ ] Pick up package from 42nd St locker before Saturday
- [ ] Grocery: milk, eggs, spinach, coffee pods
- [ ] Send birthday note to Tom (Sat) - schedule card and slack message

Small reminders / scribbles:
- Try increasing kernel log level for the next repro run (only for short window).
- Add specific prompt set for eval that triggers the regression (two examples attached in GH issue).
- If perf tests still flaky, add headroom to CI so nightly doesn't block merges (follow infra cadence).

Brainstorm bullets (for later doc):
- Could we expose an "adaptive_batching" telemetry metric per route? Would help correlate latency spikes with batching decisions.
- Consider a canary tagging scheme: model-variant + commit-hash + region to make rollbacks unambiguous.

Notes to self:
- Prioritize fix for KV cache race (highest impact on stability).
- Keep canary window small and monitor tokens/sec + 95th latency spikes.

References:
- INF-1234 (jira) - perf regression tracking
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/567
- Confluence: serving-runtime/canary-rollout-plan

End of scratchpad.
